meaningKo: 자신의 행동을 정리하다, 더 나은 방향으로 나아가다
exampleEn: You really need to get your act together if you want to pass the exam.
exampleKo: 시험을 통과하고 싶다면 정말로 행동을 정리해야 해.
gameExamples: It’s time for you to get your act together and start focusing on your goals.
If you want to improve your grades, you have to get your act together before the next semester.
She realized she needed to get your act together after missing several deadlines at work.
